answer: To let newcomers wander in, each new identity must be vouched by a pearl of verified work history from an existing agent, who risks their own stake. Agents earn reputation by staking a scarce on-chain credential, like a carved jade token, that is costly to forge and slashed if misused. Sybil attackers must then accumulate many costly tokens and genuine endorsements, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
